exchange.error.damaged: This file is damaged. Ask for a new copy.
exchange.error.newerFormat: This file was saved by a newer translationCore (project format {format}). Update translationCore, then receive the file again. Nothing was changed.
exchange.error.unreadable: The file could not be read: {reason}
exchange.error.verifyFailed: The file on the drive could not be read back correctly, so it was deleted. Save it again, or use another drive.
feedback.attachmentFailed: translationCore could not gather these details ({reason}), so Send stays off. Close this window and open it again to try again.
home.unusable.folderUnreadable: This folder could not be read: {reason}. Nothing in the folder was changed.
home.unusable.link: This is a link to a folder somewhere else. translationCore opens only folders inside its projects folder: move the folder here to open it.
home.unusable.nameNotAllowed: translationCore cannot open a folder with this name: a name cannot hold : \ or /, or be only dots and spaces. Rename the folder.
home.unusable.nameNotText: This folder's name is not text translationCore can read. Rename the folder.
home.unusable.noProjectFile: This folder holds a project's files but no ingredients/tc/project.json, so translationCore cannot open it. If it is a translationCore 4.0 project, import it. Nothing in the folder was changed.
home.unusable.projectFileDamaged: Its project file (ingredients/tc/project.json) is damaged: {reason}. Nothing in the folder was changed.
home.unusable.projectFileUnreadable: Its project file (ingredients/tc/project.json) could not be read: {reason}. Nothing in the folder was changed.
newBible.codeAdjusted: Door43 lists this language as {door43}, a code a project cannot hold. The project uses {code} and keeps {door43} as its Door43 code.
newBible.codeUnusable: Door43 lists this language as {door43}, a code a project cannot use. Type a code for it.
openDoor43.refused.notOpened: tC4 could not get the project from Door43. Make sure that the repository name is correct. No project was added to this computer.
prepare.failed: The bundled resources could not be prepared. Please quit and try again.
prepare.lead: Getting resources ready for offline use.
prepare.title: Preparing translationCore4
refusal.open.lock-held: Another program is using this project (process {pid} on {host}). Close it, or restart the computer, then open the project again. Nothing was changed.
refusal.open.lock-held-unnamed: Another program is using this project. Close it, or restart the computer, then open the project again. Nothing was changed.
refusal.open.newer-format: This project was saved by a newer translationCore (project format {format}). Update translationCore, then open the project again. Nothing was changed.
syncResult.error.keptStopped: Your teammates' changes were received and kept, but the sync stopped: {reason}
syncResult.error.needsNewerApp: A teammate uses a newer translationCore (project format {format}). Update translationCore, then sync again. Nothing changed.
syncResult.error.notSent: Your teammates' changes were received and kept, but tC4 could not send your changes to Door43. Sync again.
syncResult.error.projectMismatch: This Door43 repository holds a different project, so the sync stopped. Two projects are never combined. Nothing changed.
syncResult.error.readOnly: This project is open read-only, so it cannot sync.
syncResult.error.tc4TeamRepository: This project is shared by translationCore 4, so the sync stopped. Nothing changed. Move the team to the new translationCore first.
syncResult.receivedKept: Your teammates' changes were received and kept.
upload.notWritten: The file could not be copied into translationCore: {reason}. Nothing was changed.
